mapper.sql: id, employee_id, version, is_latest, effective_date, expiry_date, audit_status, base_salary, probation_base_salary, currency, change_reason, remark, delete_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time
mapper.select:
SELECT sa.id, sa.employee_id, sa.version, sa.is_latest, sa.effective_date, sa.expiry_date, sa.audit_status, sa.base_salary, sa.probation_base_salary, sa.currency, sa.change_reason, sa.version, sa.remark, se.employee_name, se.employee_code FROM salary_archive sa INNER JOIN salary_employee se ON sa.employee_id = se.id AND se.delete_flag = 0 WHERE sa.delete_flag = 0
AND sa.is_latest = #{req.isLatest}
AND (se.employee_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{req.keyword}, '%') OR se.employee_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{req.keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY sa.update_time DESC

SELECT sa.id, sa.employee_id, sa.version, sa.is_latest, sa.effective_date, sa.expiry_date, sa.audit_status, sa.base_salary, sa.probation_base_salary, sa.currency, sa.change_reason, sa.version, sa.remark, se.employee_name, se.employee_code, sai.type_id, sai.item_type, sai.calc_type, sai.base_amount, sai.amount, sai.ratio, -- 动态判断：如果是收入项去收入字典查，如果是扣款项去扣款字典查 CASE WHEN sai.item_type = 1 THEN sit.type_name WHEN sai.item_type = 2 THEN sdt.type_name END AS type_name, CASE WHEN sai.item_type = 1 THEN sit.type_code WHEN sai.item_type = 2 THEN sdt.type_code END AS type_code FROM salary_archive sa INNER JOIN salary_employee se ON sa.employee_id = se.id AND se.delete_flag = 0 LEFT JOIN salary_archive_item sai ON sa.id = sai.archive_id AND sai.delete_flag = 0 -- 关联收入字典 LEFT JOIN salary_income_type sit ON sai.item_type = 1 AND sai.type_id = sit.id AND sit.delete_flag = 0 -- 关联扣款字典 LEFT JOIN salary_deduction_type sdt ON sai.item_type = 2 AND sai.type_id = sdt.id AND sdt.delete_flag = 0 WHERE sa.id = #{archiveId} AND sa.delete_flag = 0

SELECT sa.id, sa.employee_id, sa.version, sa.is_latest, sa.effective_date, sa.expiry_date, sa.audit_status, sa.base_salary, sa.probation_base_salary, sa.currency, sa.change_reason, sa.version, sa.remark, se.employee_name, se.employee_code, sai.type_id, sai.item_type, sai.calc_type, sai.base_amount, sai.amount, sai.ratio, CASE WHEN sai.item_type = 1 THEN sit.type_name WHEN sai.item_type = 2 THEN sdt.type_name END AS type_name, CASE WHEN sai.item_type = 1 THEN sit.type_code WHEN sai.item_type = 2 THEN sdt.type_code END AS type_code FROM salary_archive sa INNER JOIN salary_employee se ON sa.employee_id = se.id AND se.delete_flag = 0 LEFT JOIN salary_archive_item sai ON sa.id = sai.archive_id AND sai.delete_flag = 0 LEFT JOIN salary_income_type sit ON sai.item_type = 1 AND sai.type_id = sit.id AND sit.delete_flag = 0 LEFT JOIN salary_deduction_type sdt ON sai.item_type = 2 AND sai.type_id = sdt.id AND sdt.delete_flag = 0 WHERE sa.employee_id = #{employeeId} AND sa.is_latest = 1 AND sa.audit_status = 1 -- 只查审核通过的生效版本 AND sa.delete_flag = 0

SELECT sa.id, sa.employee_id, sa.version, sa.is_latest, sa.effective_date, sa.base_salary, sa.probation_base_salary, sa.currency, sa.change_reason, sa.version, sa.remark, se.employee_name, se.employee_code, sai.type_id, sai.item_type, sai.calc_type, sai.base_amount, sai.amount, sai.ratio, CASE WHEN sai.item_type = 1 THEN sit.type_name WHEN sai.item_type = 2 THEN sdt.type_name END AS type_name, CASE WHEN sai.item_type = 1 THEN sit.type_code WHEN sai.item_type = 2 THEN sdt.type_code END AS type_code FROM salary_employee se -- 必须有生效档案的员工才参与核算 INNER JOIN salary_archive sa ON se.id = sa.employee_id AND sa.is_latest = 1 AND sa.audit_status = 1 AND sa.delete_flag = 0 -- 关联明细项 LEFT JOIN salary_archive_item sai ON sa.id = sai.archive_id AND sai.delete_flag = 0 LEFT JOIN salary_income_type sit ON sai.item_type = 1 AND sai.type_id = sit.id AND sit.delete_flag = 0 LEFT JOIN salary_deduction_type sdt ON sai.item_type = 2 AND sai.type_id = sdt.id AND sdt.delete_flag = 0 WHERE se.employment_status = 1 -- 只要在职的 AND se.delete_flag = 0
